title: Clean cookies, stay signed in
caption: See every cookie a site stores, purge them in one click, and trust the sites you want to stay logged in to.

title: Spot third-party trackers
caption: The Third-party view lists the ad and analytics domains on this page that keep cookies, so you can delete them.

title: Find high-risk cookies fast
caption: The Explorer groups every cookie in Chrome by site and flags trackers and long-lived or insecure cookies.

title: Automatic, scheduled, measurable
caption: Track what was cleared each day, deep-clean site storage, and schedule purges every hour, 6 hours or day.

title: Safe Havens for trusted sites
caption: Trusted domains and their subdomains are never cleaned automatically.
